[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''Ezekiel Glasgow''' was born about 1785 in Pennsylvania. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1134|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Kilpatrick-1665|Hannah Kilpatrick]].

Ezekiel died on 23 April 1814 in Beaver County, Pennsylvania. His memorial identifies his burial at Beaver Cemetery and Mausoleum and describes him as the first pastor of First Presbyterian Church of Beaver. It says that his grave was moved from the old Beaver cemetery to the present lot in 1976.<ref name="EzekielMemorial">[https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/157440876/ezekiel-glasgow Find a Grave memorial 157440876], Rev. Ezekiel Glasgow, Beaver Cemetery and Mausoleum; memorial narrative, accessed 28 August 2026.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1134]] is assessed at 93% (proved). Samuel Glasgow’s family memorial account explicitly lists Ezekiel among his children. Ezekiel’s c 1785 birth is compatible with Samuel and Hannah Kilpatrick’s stated household.

Confident compiled child list; Samuel’s burial citation is not presented as Ezekiel’s own burial or a contemporary birth entry.

Next useful test: Compare Samuel’s probate or family register with the memorial child list.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/85298095/samuel-glasgow Find a Grave memorial 85298095 (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/85298095/samuel-glasgow), Samuel Glasgow.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The former citation used Find a Grave memorial 85298095. That memorial belongs to Ezekiel's father Samuel Glasgow and lists Ezekiel as a child; it is not evidence for Ezekiel's own burial. The church and cemetery records underlying memorial 157440876 should be sought for primary confirmation.

=== Possible Ezekiel Glasgow, Charlestown postal addressee, 1775 ===
James Glasgow and Ezekiel Glasgow appear in the list of letters remaining in Charlestown’s General Post Office, dated 21 August 1775.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/605068969/ The South-Carolina and American General Gazette, 1775-08-25, p.1].</ref>

The postal list gives neither an age nor a family relationship between James and Ezekiel. An addressee need not have been an adult or resident at the post office.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1135]]. Birth 1785, Pennsylvania, uncertain; death 23 Apr 1814, Beaver County, Pennsylvania, exact. The recorded uncertain birth year is after the 1775 entry and is a substantial chronological mismatch, but not a hard exclusion from an uncertain date alone. No South Carolina connection was found.
